mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_keyword_daily (stat_date, keyword, search_cnt, zero_cnt) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, #{keyword}, 1, #{zeroCnt}::integer) ON CONFLICT (stat_date, keyword) DO UPDATE SET search_cnt = search_keyword_daily.search_cnt + 1, zero_cnt = search_keyword_daily.zero_cnt + EXCLUDED.zero_cnt
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM search_keyword_daily WHERE stat_date <= CURRENT_DATE - #{days}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT d.keyword FROM search_keyword_daily d WHERE d.stat_date > CURRENT_DATE - #{days}::integer AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_keyword_hide h WHERE h.keyword = d.keyword AND h.use_yn = 'Y') AND d.keyword ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' GROUP BY d.keyword HAVING SUM(d.search_cnt) >= #{minCount}::integer AND SUM(d.search_cnt) > SUM(d.zero_cnt) ORDER BY SUM(d.search_cnt) DESC, d.keyword LIMIT #{limitCnt}::integer
mapper.sql:
WHERE d.stat_date > CURRENT_DATE - #{days}::integer
AND d.keyword ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\'
GROUP BY d.keyword HAVING SUM(d.zero_cnt) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT d.keyword, SUM(d.search_cnt)::TEXT AS search_cnt, SUM(d.zero_cnt)::TEXT AS zero_cnt, TO_CHAR(MAX(d.stat_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS last_date, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_keyword_hide h WHERE h.keyword = d.keyword AND h.use_yn = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hidden_yn FROM search_keyword_daily d
ORDER BY SUM(d.zero_cnt) DESC, SUM(d.search_cnt) DESC, d.keyword LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT TO_CHAR(g.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stat_date, COALESCE(SUM(d.search_cnt), 0)::TEXT AS search_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(d.zero_cnt), 0)::TEXT AS zero_cnt, COUNT(d.keyword)::TEXT AS keyword_cnt FROM generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - (#{days}::integer - 1), CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1 day') AS g(day) LEFT JOIN search_keyword_daily d ON d.stat_date = g.day::date GROUP BY g.day ORDER BY g.day DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM search_keyword_hide WHERE keyword = #{keyword} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_keyword_hide (keyword, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{keyword}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE search_keyword_hide SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE keyword = #{keyword} AND use_yn = 'Y'
